title: PDC gap register is an unmaintained P2 snapshot: no status, severity or owner column, and many listed gaps are already resolved or accepted
impact: The register lists 107 requirement gaps with no status. P7 reports and the P8 audit show 60 RESOLVED and 3 ACCEPTED (stale_vs_baseline=true) and 43 OPEN, but neither the register nor PDC_INDEX (P8 shown "Not started", P7 reports unlisted) reflects this. Severity and owner are derivable only from the ID prefix and the P7 reports.
recommendation: Add status/severity/owner/last-verdict columns, or supersede the register with the P9 debt register, so closure and the ARCH-FREEZE entry check read one current list.

title: PDC-D6-R017 (MCP exposure security) waits on a stage that is already closed; no later source audits it
impact: Register and matrix keep R017 BLOCKED_EXACT_REASON "await MCP-SERVER-X P8"; P8 s4 records MCP-SERVER-X CLOSED (PASS_SCOPED). P7-D6 left R017 unaudited (fastmcp absent, F-D6-19 INFO) and P8 s7-9 do not cover it: the dependency is satisfied but the obligation has no executing owner (orphaned chain).
recommendation: Assign R017 to a named audit step (run the two MCP security modules with fastmcp present) or record it as an accepted scoped limitation under MCP-SERVER-X PASS_SCOPED.

title: 43 PDC gap rows are still OPEN at the baseline while PDC-X P8 is PARTIAL_EXACT_BLOCKERS; they sit in the ARCH-FREEZE precondition
impact: Rows PARTIAL at P7 and not (fully) repaired: remainders are declared exceptions (F-D1-01 HIGH attestation never verified before install/upgrade; F-D8-01 HIGH retention not enforced in any composition; F-D1-04, F-D5-02, F-D7-03), unrepaired MEDIUM debt, or partially fixed items (G-01..G-03). PDC-X is not closed (P9 not started), so ARCH-FREEZE stays blocked; no per-row re-verdict was issued after the repair loop. HIGH not claimed (E2 only).
recommendation: Per-row re-verdict in the P9 debt register: close, or convert to explicit Operator-accepted exceptions with owner and reopen condition.

title: Exception- or scope-terminated deferral chains without a stage owner: host drain, DIST-SCALE-X, Collaborative Work hard delete, TENANT-X/CTRL-X
impact: PDC-D7-R014 (lane P6) -> P7 FAIL F-D7-03 -> declared exception (DELEGATION-PDC-CLOSE d.1) -> "Operator commissions the feature"; PDC-D4-R005 shares the unreachable drain seam (F-D4-02). F-D7-20 (stop() abandons a running thread, later start() runs two consumers) is a real bug in production-composed code filed LOW though P8 says re-rate MEDIUM. D7-R021 points at DIST-SCALE-X scoped with a stale doc; D8-R009 relies on Collaborative Work deferring hard delete. Each chain ends at an Operator decision with no scheduled stage.
recommendation: Give each chain a named owner stage, re-rate F-D7-20, and record reopen conditions in the P9 debt register.

title: Documentation rows still PARTIAL after P5-DOC; same obligation counted under two IDs
impact: Docs closed in P5-DOC were found stale or wrong at P7 (AGENT_DISTRIBUTION plan row, BACKGROUND_TASKS statuses, matrix composition-root cell F-D7-16). D2-R008/D6-R014 and D2-R018/D8-R019 carry the identical test; D6-R022 is D6-owned but listed in lane D8, so closure counts can double count.
recommendation: Doc fixes by owner; dedupe the shared obligations in the matrix.
